maya: Need a 1-page field flashcard for AMs: enterprise security, SLA snapshot, deploy-mode cheatline.

sam: Keep it bite-sized, 6 lines front, tiny benchmark table on back.

olivia: Include typical p95 numbers (mark "typical, workload dependent").

leo: Draft front lines:
1) SOC2 Type II; optional VPC/private control plane; KMS/HSM; audit logs export.
2) Hosted = fastest TT V; Dedicated = reserved GPU pools + 99.9% uptime; Private = on-prem/VPC for regulated workloads.
3) Typical p95: Dedicated ~70-120ms; Hosted ~100-200ms (varies by workload).
4) Cost levers: batching, KV caching, quantization (recommendations provided).
5) Routing: self-serve if < $100k ARR or <1M tokens/mo; sales-assisted otherwise.
6) CTAs: "Start free hosted trial" / "Request Dedicated eval".

sam: Back panel table: rows: small gen, long-chat, embeddings batch; columns: p95 hosted, p95 dedicated, note.

olivia: Add enterprise upsells: extended log retention, custom audit exports. I'll validate numbers with infra.

maya: Great. @sam @leo please hand to design by tomorrow noon PST. launch-bot: template link posted. :rocket:
